purpose: Produce the smallest offline-verifiable evidence bundle capable of measuring maker execution economics without reconstructing fills, books, fees, rebates, inventory, or settlements.

current_mission_authority.note: This file is a command and output contract for a separately authorized production-side read-only export. It is not authority to run it.

source_scope.range_reason: The first complete target date after the frozen mirror's 2026-08-12 05:03 cutoff through the report cutoff. Partial 2026-08-12 evidence is excluded.
source_scope.market_scope: Every International weather market with a maker quote opportunity or authenticated maker order lifecycle in the date range; do not add markets merely because book snapshots exist.

path_rules: Resolve every root and file before reading and reject reparse points or escapes.
Record paths relative to a separately hashed source-root identity; never export a usable credential path.
Open source files read-only and never create a cache, lock, sidecar, or temporary file below a source root.
Hash complete source-file bytes before admitting any extracted record.
Reject a source file if its bytes, size, schema, or path identity changes during the pass.
record_binding_rules: Every extracted record carries source_file_sha256, source_row_ordinal, source_byte_offset, source_byte_count, and source_record_sha256.
JSONL source_record_sha256 is over the exact source line bytes excluding the line terminator; CSV source_record_sha256 is over the exact RFC-4180 logical record bytes.
Every derived row lists all source_record_sha256 values in role order and carries a canonical derivation_sha256.
Token id, condition id, event slug, market id, target date, outcome label, and band must agree across every joined record. Any mismatch excludes the entire lifecycle.
Input revisions remain visible. Exactly one terminal revision may be selected by documented source authority; no last-row-wins inference is allowed.

evidence_classes.quote_opportunity: A distinct, source-bound maker decision at a captured book state. It is not a fill or independent market-day support.
evidence_classes.simulated_fill: A paper or queue-model result. Retain for comparison only; never include in authenticated fill rate, realized P&L, or settlement P&L.
evidence_classes.observed_public_trade: A public CLOB execution observation. It may provide a non-reconstructed price path but cannot prove our fill, queue position, fee, rebate, inventory, or P&L.
evidence_classes.authenticated_fill: A confirmed own-account trade bound to an exact maker address, condition, token, exchange order id, trade id, transaction hash, liquidity role, price, size, fee rate, status, user-stream row, and REST trade reconciliation.
evidence_classes.settlement: One authority-selected WU settlement per market and target date with its revision/source audit binding.

serialization.tabular: UTF-8 JSONL, one canonical JSON object per LF-terminated line, keys sorted lexicographically, no NaN or Infinity
serialization.objects: Exact source bytes for selected raw evidence or canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and one trailing LF
serialization.timestamps: RFC 3339 UTC with Z and at least millisecond precision when the source supplies it
serialization.numbers: Decimal strings in native units; no binary-float rendering in evidence rows

content_addressed_layout.rule: The manifest maps logical artifact names to object SHA-256 and byte count. Object names equal their complete-byte SHA-256. Publication stages in a sibling directory, fsyncs files and directories, atomically renames once, and refuses any existing destination or hash collision.

inclusion_rules: Select only polymarket_global rows inside the exact target-date and as-of bounds.
A quote opportunity requires an exact quote-intent row, exact event/token identity, and a fresh two-sided book state captured no more than 1000 milliseconds before the decision.

An authenticated fill requires confirmed agreement between the final user-stream journal, exact REST order response, and exact REST account-trade response; public trades and simulations never substitute.

A markout requires uninterrupted public tape and complete two-sided books from the fill through the checkpoint. Select the first complete midpoint at or after exactly 1, 5, or 15 minutes, no more than 1000 milliseconds late.
A settlement requires the authority-selected WU daily-summary revision, source audit PASS, native-unit match, and exact market/date/token mapping.
Each market and target date contributes once to support regardless of snapshots, retries, runs, ledger revisions, orders, or fills.
Preserve every admitted quote opportunity and lifecycle row; aggregation happens only after the compact export verifies.
exclusion_and_stop_rules: Exclude all Polymarket US compatibility rows.
Exclude every reconstructed, backfilled, simulated, inferred, or time-interpolated execution or book row from realized economics.
Exclude a lifecycle on any source hash, schema, identity, timestamp, unit, revision-authority, or containment mismatch.
Exclude a lifecycle if any selected markout window intersects an open or closed capture gap, parse rejection, stale book, missing side, token remap, or event revision.
Exclude authenticated-fill metrics when a confirmed own-account trade set is not complete and hash-bound.
Primary-liquidity incentives, maker rebates, and rewards equal decimal zero unless exact accepted and reconciled evidence proves a nonzero realized amount. Estimates never count.
Do not substitute configured fee rates for actual fee reconciliation. Missing actual fees make after-cost accounting incomplete.
Do not publish a partial bundle. Any required missing family, total-size overflow, or non-deterministic rerun ends with NEEDS_EXACT_PRODUCTION_EXPORT and no final destination.

derived_economics_contract.inventory_pnl_usdc: settled cashflow plus ending marked inventory minus starting cash and starting marked inventory, excluding fees and proved incentives
derived_economics_contract.net_pnl_usdc: gross trading cashflow + settlement/redemption cashflow + proved incentives + proved maker rebates - actual fees
derived_economics_contract.precision: Compute with decimal arithmetic in native units and USDC; retain unrounded components and round presentation only.

required_behavior: Run locally on production under a separately reviewed read-only mission; do not use Scheduler.
Open only explicitly indexed source roots and never follow reparse points.
Use bounded streaming reads, external partitions under the new destination staging root, and at most 256 MiB resident working memory.
Sort and join by canonical identity keys, never by filesystem enumeration order.
Create no source-side files and perform no network, credential, provider, exchange, model, release, promotion, or trade action.
Run twice against unchanged source identities and require byte-identical object and manifest hashes before publication.

workstation_verification_rules: Receive only the content-addressed export directory, never copied production paths or credentials.
Require an ordinary fixed-volume directory with no reparse points and no object outside the export root.
Require total bytes <= 67108864 and file count <= 128 before parsing.
Verify every object path, byte count, SHA-256, manifest hash, producer receipt hash, schema, row count, and source-record binding.

Require the producer receipt to bind the exact source Git tip/tree, reducer code hash, spec file hash, source-root identities, command tokens, date bounds, as-of timestamp, and two deterministic pass hashes.
Require sorted unique quote-opportunity and authenticated-fill keys; reject duplicate terminal revisions and conflicting lifecycle identities.
Require all requested markout windows to be gap-free and book-fresh; never interpolate or reconstruct.
Require one countability row per market x target date and compute support only from countable rows.
Recompute all decimal economics, fee reconciliation, zero-default incentives, market-day counts, and source-to-derived hashes.
Keep pre- and post-2026-07-31 regimes in separate output partitions and separate crossed target-date x market bootstrap calculations.
Only after all verification passes may a workstation mission compute economics or return MAKER_ECONOMICS_MEASURED.
